method: Independent agent editorial/clinical review with a second novice-editor agent and rendered browser tests. This is not human user research.

baseline.extraction: Visible text nodes; excludes sr-only and closed details; includes visual axis labels and units, not canvas glyph text.

iterations.candidate: Short labels Lab range/Prevention, Within range/Discuss cardiovascular risk, same numeric thresholds, generic free-upload action.
findings: Prevention label does not teach why the same in-range result deserves another perspective.
Conditional confirmation should remain next to risk interpretation.
Generic Start for free/Upload your labs does not itself explain EVA's interpretation benefit.
iterations.revision_prompt: Name the two questions the one unchanged measurement answers; retain confirmation and context; make the free action state the interpretation benefit. Remove duplicated plot/readout labels structurally rather than removing critical qualifications.

iterations.candidate: One result. Two questions. Within the lab range? / Yes, in this example. Cardiovascular risk? / Discuss if confirmed. Interpretation-first free action.
findings: Core same-value/two-cutoff meaning is clearer.
Wider health context should remain visibly adjacent to the risk verdict.
Question-and-answer repetition in lab row may add words despite cleaner structure.
iterations.revision_prompt: Add the shortest natural context qualifier to the conditional risk verdict. Keep the interpretation benefit in the CTA. Reduce question/answer redundancy; measure actual closed-view words before claiming meaningful text reduction.

iterations.candidate: Discuss if confirmed. Context matters. / Valorar si se confirma. El contexto importa. Understand your labs/Upload for free; Entiende tus análisis/Súbelos gratis.
findings: Clinical confirmation and context are explicit.
CTA now states interpretation benefit and free upload.
Final hierarchy and text/height reductions must be measured from actual implementation.
Independent novice-editor passed all five English questions once confirmation/context and interpretation-first CTA were present.
Two readings was rejected as potentially implying two measurements; final bridge uses Two questions.
iterations.revision_prompt: Retain this meaning, remove repeated labels and redundant lab question/answer wording, then render both languages. Do not claim the original25% word target if actual counts miss it; prioritize clinical/novice meaning and document any revised density criterion.

iterations.candidate: Meaningful labels integrated beside a narrow right-hand graph.
findings: At ES320 the narrow graph and detached axis lost visual teaching weight while text still dominated.
A smaller total height alone was insufficient aesthetic evidence.
iterations.revision_prompt: Use broad full-width rails, each directly owned by its label, threshold and short verdict. Keep aligned42% points,40% prevention threshold and one shared0–5 axis.

iterations.candidate: Broad rails with the new explanatory bridge inside glass.
findings: Association and rail width improved.
Fresh preflight showed glass-height reduction was insufficient and desktop glass grew.
iterations.revision_prompt: Move the one-result/two-questions bridge below the headline on paper; retain16px/24px body styling and keep the glass focused on evidence.

iterations.candidate: Final lean bilingual copy, interpretation-first free CTA, bridge on paper and two broad semantic rails.
